clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Echo Isles off Durotar's southeastern coast, tigers supply fur for the Darkspear, whose refugee population keeps growing. The trolls use the pelts for blankets, tents, and armor.

In Sen'jin Village, the Darkspear must make scarce supplies last. They let the local tigers thrive until their growing needs call for a cull. Trolls cure the thick hides into goods their settlement needs, including protective armor and warm blankets for changing seasonal weather.

The Echo Isles lie south of Durotar, across open water. The Darkspear once called the archipelago home, until the witch doctor Zalazane drove them out. Hunters face dangers from Zalazane's thralls and from tigers waiting among the thick foliage. Experienced hunters such as Vel'rin Fang speak of spending entire days motionless in the jungle brush to secure a single clean kill.
